programs.name: CL-ECI research program
programs.program_rule: ECI, CL, and the CL-ECI synthesis are related but non-interchangeable papers. A route must state which contribution it is evaluating, and overlapping full-paper submissions require an explicit originality/overlap check.

campaigns.asset: From Energy Signals to Constrained Claims
campaigns.terminal_objective: Externally reviewed synthesis paper that preserves the layered progression from admissible economic signal to claim-level evidence to binding constraint without claiming monetary performance that has not been demonstrated.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Protect the synthesis as the primary integrated manuscript and prevent CL, ECI, Policy Lab, or fallback venues from becoming duplicate publication variants of the same contribution.

routes.note: Official FC'27 CFP now lists 2026-09-24 23:59 AoE as the firm paper deadline; the older master route still carries 2026-09-17 and requires later registry reconciliation.

next_actions: Treat FC'27 as the live primary integrated-paper route and use the official 2026-09-24 firm deadline, not the stale Sep-17 registry date.
Run a manuscript-fit and page-budget check against FC'27 short-paper requirements before submission packaging.
Keep FTSID as a fallback only if FC'27 is stopped or the artifact is demonstrably non-overlapping.
Record any reviewer feedback against the four-boundary synthesis rather than promoting the Policy Lab implementation into evidence the papers do not contain.
nonclaims: Do not claim that energy adjacency alone creates economic information.
Do not claim that economic information alone creates claim-level evidence.
Do not claim that claim-level evidence alone creates a binding financial constraint.
Do not claim monetary performance, legal-money status, market adoption, or general acceptability from the current prototype.
success_signals: peer-reviewed external verdict on the synthesis
reviewer-driven improvement to boundary definitions or evidence
proceedings publication or a stronger non-overlapping journal path
preserved separation between academic evidence and executable demonstration

campaigns.asset: When Does Energy Track the Real Economy?
campaigns.terminal_objective: Standalone measurement/admissibility paper establishing when an energy-adjacent signal deserves economic interpretation for a defined real-activity purpose.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Demonstrate that the ECI paper remains a distinct standalone contribution after the synthesis freeze and is submission-ready without copying the CL-ECI integrated argument.

historical_routes.lesson: Strong native fit for energy finance/sustainable-finance specificity; use that venue profile when searching the next route rather than forcing ECI into generic software calls.

next_actions: Reconfirm the standalone ECI manuscript and empirical reproduction package against the frozen synthesis.
If distinct and ready, run a targeted sustainable-finance/energy-finance venue census rather than a generic finance CFP sweep.
Do not reuse FC'27 synthesis copy as an ECI submission.

campaigns.asset: The Constrained Ledger: When Does Energy Actually Discipline Digital Money?
campaigns.terminal_objective: Distinct institutional-constraint paper explaining when evidence becomes a binding financial constraint through issuance, pricing, settlement, and governance conditions.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Preserve CL as a general institutional architecture rather than merely extracting the architecture sections of the CL-ECI synthesis under a new title.

routes.note: Only a genuine IL x CL tax-workflow/agentic-AI derivative qualifies; this is not the default CL manuscript route.

next_actions: Freeze what CL contributes independently of ECI and the synthesis.
Do not create a second full-paper submission by retitling the integrated CL-ECI contribution.
Use architecture/institutional venues only where authorization, policy-as-code, settlement, governance, or evidence-to-authority boundaries are native fit.

campaigns.terminal_objective: Externally tested, archived, journal-submission-ready comparative digital-tax paper followed by one deliberate journal submission.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Convert specialist feedback and funding without diluting transaction-path comparison, activation specificity, transaction-control constraint, or Stage A versus Stage B capacity.
next_actions: Resolve Tax Academy live mechanics and eligibility for the already-prepared Singapore extension packet.
Keep ATTA abstract as the first specialist submission sequence.
Keep ATAx abstract second while preserving acceptance-stage cost gating.
Treat IPSA as funding-dependent rather than prestige-driven.
Wait for genuine ICPP8 and IRSPM panel/call fit before additional packet work.
Defer final journal choice until useful external feedback arrives or conference validation stops adding value.
success_signals: accepted and presented specialist conference paper
documented revision caused by external scholarly feedback

campaigns.terminal_objective: Frozen, reproducible, thesis-backed flagship paper on cross-record economic observability followed by external field validation and journal submission.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Explicitly freeze the issuer/sample perimeter and canonical empirical hierarchy before presenting the empirical core externally.
next_actions: Obtain explicit advisor ratification or rejection of the proposed scope-labelled issuer rule.
Update canonical authority files only after that decision.
Rerun certification and reproducibility under the approved rule.
Align thesis and manuscript to the same empirical hierarchy.
Only then convert SASE Network J or another genuinely matching field-validation route.
nonclaims: Do not revive the hidden-economy residual framing.
Do not equate GTV, issuer revenue, merchant sales, payment flows, GDP/value added, or taxable base.
Do not relax comparability to increase sample size for a venue.

campaigns.terminal_objective: Reproducible publication candidate or explicitly retained falsification result that survives replication and identification audit.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Replicate the original estimates and preserve CEIR's role as a tested shortcut falsification rather than silently treating it as ECI or claim-level evidence.

campaigns.terminal_objective: Defensible empirical working paper with complete sample, identification, robustness, and contribution boundaries.
campaigns.current_decisive_gate: Complete data/sample audit and identification/DiD design audit before route discovery.
